instruction: In VLC, increase the maximum volume to 200% and also disable the background cone/logo display.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully navigated VLC Advanced Preferences > Interface > Main interfaces > Qt, found the volume slider color setting, changed it to black (0;0;0), and saved preferences.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open VLC Tools menu, navigate to Advanced Preferences, expand Interface tree to Qt settings, modify multiple input fields and checkboxes, and save preferences.
metadata.task_rationale: The agent demonstrated proficiency with VLC Qt preferences. This harder variation requires modifying two different settings on the same page, testing multi-step configuration ability with partial credit.
metadata.explanation: Task requires changing two Qt settings: qt-max-volume to 200 and qt-bgcone to 0. Custom getter reads both values from vlcrc. Custom metric awards 0.5 for each correct setting, enabling partial credit.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads vlcrc config file and parses both qt-max-volume and qt-bgcone settings, skipping commented lines
Metric correctly accesses expected parameter as the rules dict directly (expected.get('expected_qt_max_volume')), consistent with get_rule returning config['rules']
Both instruction requirements are fully covered: max volume 200% and disable background cone/logo
Partial credit scoring (0.5 per setting) is well-designed for a two-requirement task
Expected values ('200' for max volume, '0' for bgcone disabled) are semantically correct for the instruction
Postconfig kills and relaunches VLC to ensure config is written to disk before getter reads vlcrc
